selection.amplitude_convention: S4G cosine amplitude = 2*abs(sum(m exp(2i phi)))/sum(m) within annulus; constant stellar mass-to-light assumption

rules: All endpoint sensitivities refer to 3 Gyr. Values at different evolutionary stages are not silently substituted.

Force and timestep comparisons reuse particle realizations; increasing particle count also changes the realization. Same-height seed repeats share the frozen smooth construction, not the sampled phase-space state.
Percentages are descriptive differences with stated denominators, not independent Gaussian uncertainty estimates. No quadrature sum or combined confidence interval is constructed.
The original threshold belongs to its specified numerical-stability check. It is not a newly imposed pass criterion for seed scatter, centre choice, or every physical intervention.
Conservation, phase reconstruction, mock bias and observed population spread test different things. A pass in one category does not waive failure or incomplete coverage in another.
Mock medians use distinct qualified epoch sets and sometimes capped apertures. They are not an isolated thickness or seed effect on estimator bias.
The static halo also removes azimuthal particle noise; the thickness family retains sampled matching confounds. Neither contrast uniquely identifies a torque, buckling or resonance mechanism.
This chosen gas-free disc/halo family is not an observed population or a CDM/SIDM discrimination experiment. The bounded reduced diffusion study is separate and retains its weak-diffusion failure.
